libreOfficeGate.offer: This conversion needs the LibreOffice engine: a one-time ~{mb} MB download (Wi-Fi recommended) that then works offline. Enabling it reloads the page; you can add your files afterwards.
libreOfficeGate.reload: Reload the page normally to use this converter
libreOfficeGate.unsupported: This browser cannot enable the engine (it needs service workers and Cache Storage, which private windows often turn off). Try a normal Chrome, Edge or Firefox window.
libreOfficeGate.enableFailed: Could not enable it. Check that the browser allows site data and try again.

warnings.svgExternalResources: The SVG uses external fonts or images that cannot load offline; they were left out.

errors.generic: This file couldn't be converted. Try another file or a different output format.
errors.decode: The file couldn't be read. Check that it isn't damaged and that it's in the expected format.
errors.drm: This book has DRM (copy protection) and can't be converted. Try a DRM-free copy.
errors.timeout: The conversion took too long. Try again; if it happens again, try a smaller file.
errors.reloadEngine: Reload the page normally to use this converter.
errors.engineDownload: The conversion engine couldn't be downloaded. Check your connection and try again.
errors.documentConvert: The document couldn't be converted. Check that it opens correctly in your editor or try another output format.
errors.wordRead: The Word document couldn't be read. Check that it is a valid .docx and isn't damaged.
errors.pdfPassword: The PDF is password-protected. Remove the password and try again.
errors.pdfRestricted: This PDF has security restrictions that prevent converting it to Word. Try an unrestricted copy.
errors.pdfNoText: This PDF has no text to extract; it is probably a scan or contains only images.
errors.pdfRead: The PDF couldn't be read. Check that the file isn't damaged.
errors.unknownSource: The file format isn't recognised. Check its extension or choose another file.
errors.unsupportedSource: {format} files can't be converted in this mode. Choose a file in another format.
errors.invalidFile: The file doesn't look like a valid {format}. Check that its content matches its extension.
errors.tiffInvalid: The file isn't a valid TIFF. Check that it isn't damaged.
errors.tiffEmpty: The TIFF has no readable image. Try exporting it again from your editor.
errors.svgInvalid: The SVG couldn't be read. Check that it is well formed.
errors.canvas: The browser couldn't prepare the image. Close other tabs and try again.
errors.workerCrashed: The conversion stopped unexpectedly. Reload the page and try again.
errors.xmlInvalid: The XML is not valid. Check that every tag is properly closed.
errors.spreadsheetRead: The spreadsheet couldn't be read. Check that the file isn't damaged.
errors.ebookRead: The book couldn't be read. Check that the file isn't damaged.
errors.epubInvalid: The EPUB is invalid or damaged. Try opening it in a reader and exporting it again.
errors.bookEmpty: The book has no chapters. Add at least one.
errors.rangeEmpty: Enter at least one page range, for example 1-3, 5.
errors.rangeInvalid: The range “{range}” is not valid. Use numbers and hyphens, for example 1-3, 5.
errors.rangeStart: Pages start at 1. Fix the range “{range}”.
errors.rangeReversed: The range “{range}” is backwards. Put the lower page first.
errors.pdfPageCount: The PDF only has {n} page. Adjust the range. | The PDF only has {n} pages. Adjust the range.
errors.pdfNeedTwo: Add at least two PDFs to merge them.
